empirical_reconstruction.interaction_weight: one per valid identified interaction event row, summed by Plant_Best_ID x Insect_Best_ID within context
empirical_reconstruction.plant_opportunity: binary independent floral presence: identified Plant_Best_ID with positive numeric Nb_Floral_unit in Floral_abundance within context
empirical_reconstruction.observation_effort: fixed 60 min per Site x Period
empirical_reconstruction.missing_rows: interaction rows with both Best_ID fields missing and floral rows with literal NA placeholders create no taxon or pair

conditional_baseline.opportunity_network: Pool all valid interaction event rows across the 120 contexts. Plants and insects are the union of identified interaction taxa; positive baseline pairs are pairs observed at least once; baseline pair weights are pooled event counts.
conditional_baseline.plant_denominator: The pooled interacting plant set only. Floral-only plants that never occur in the pooled interaction network are retained as descriptive resource context but are outside the v9 opportunity-network denominator.
conditional_baseline.no_complete_cross_product: Never add plant x insect cross-pairs that were never observed in the pooled event data.
conditional_baseline.local_pair_denominator: For each context, restrict the pooled positive pair union to pairs whose plant endpoint is independently locally available in Floral_abundance. Pair support is evaluated only inside that locally available opportunity subset.

pre_target_structural_gate.rule: Every valid observed interaction pair must have its plant endpoint independently locally available in the same Site x Period floral-opportunity set. If not, stop before predictive adequacy because the independent plant-opportunity measurement does not cover the observed interaction support at the frozen scale.
pre_target_structural_gate.no_rescue: Do not add interaction-observed plants to the floral-opportunity set, merge periods, drop offending contexts, or change plant identity rules after inspection.

median_active_interacting_plant_fraction.definition: For each of 120 contexts, number of pooled interacting plants independently locally available from floral data divided by pooled interacting plant count; take the median across all contexts.
median_active_interacting_plant_fraction.v9_analogue: For each synthetic context, number of positive baseline plants retained by the upstream v9 plant-availability draw divided by positive baseline plant count; take the median across 120 contexts.

median_pair_support_fraction_given_activ.definition: For each empirical context with at least one pooled positive pair whose plant endpoint is locally available, observed positive pairs divided by that locally plant-conditioned pooled pair denominator; take the median across defined contexts. Contexts with zero plant-conditioned pair denominator are undefined for this conditional estimand but remain in the plant and Shannon estimands.
median_pair_support_fraction_given_activ.v9_analogue: For each synthetic context with at least one baseline positive pair attached to a plant retained by the upstream plant draw, realized positive pairs divided by that plant-conditioned baseline pair denominator; take the median across defined contexts.

interaction_shannon_relative_context_ran.definition: Across all 120 empirical contexts, including zero-interaction contexts as Shannon=0, calculate max Shannon minus min Shannon and divide by pooled-baseline interaction Shannon.
interaction_shannon_relative_context_ran.v9_analogue: Across all 120 synthetic contexts, including empty realized networks as Shannon=0, calculate max-minus-min Shannon divided by baseline Shannon.

secondary_diagnostics: mean pairwise Jaccard turnover of realized positive pair sets across the 120 contexts, with empty-set conventions reported explicitly
median and range of active pollinator fraction relative to pooled interacting insects
median and range of realized positive pair count
empirical summed floral-unit abundance per context as descriptive resource intensity only
number of zero-interaction empirical and synthetic contexts

v9_predictive_distribution.model: frozen ABM v9 from main after PR #207
v9_predictive_distribution.conditioning: Run v9 local-context realization on the empirical pooled weighted opportunity network; this is a local-layer test and does not validate v4 whole-island opportunity on Martinique.
v9_predictive_distribution.empty_context_rule: Retain empty or sparse v9 contexts exactly; never redraw support masks.
v9_predictive_distribution.conditional_pair_rule: Contexts with zero plant-conditioned pair denominator are undefined only for the conditional pair-support estimand; they are not removed from the other primary estimands.
v9_predictive_distribution.envelope: central 2.5-97.5% predictive interval calculated separately for each primary estimand
v9_predictive_distribution.adequacy_rule: The v9 mechanism survives Martinique only if the pre-target structural gate passes and all three empirical primary estimands lie inside their frozen predictive envelopes. No averaging or favorable setting selection is allowed.

claim_boundary: This is a prospective conditional test of the v9 local hierarchy on a new oceanic-island dataset with independent floral opportunity and fixed observation effort. Conditioning on the empirical pooled interaction network means a pass would support the local plant-availability/pair-support/weight mechanism class, not independently validate v4 island-scale colonization opportunity.
prohibited_after_target_inspection: change Site x Period to bi-monthly contexts
add interaction-observed plants to local floral opportunity
change primary estimands or their denominators
select a favorable support or weight strength instead of the equal-weight frozen mixture
reuse Martinique as independent confirmation of a replacement model if v9 fails
